category_edits.rationale: Scale each input embedding by 1/sqrt(1+c), where c counts earlier occurrences in the supplied causal sequence window. This may reduce repeated-item dominance while preserving embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so inference uses identical features without checkpoint changes.

def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))

        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):
